title: [YSQL] Command timeouts and Tserver crashes when creating a foreign key
body:
Jira Link: [DB-4399](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4399)
### Description

Reported by a customer, they tried to clone tables using `CREATE TABLE AS` statement:
```
create table mytest130 as select * from mytest129;
SELECT 2180302
alter table mytest130 add primary key (mykey asc);
ALTER TABLE
create table mychild130 as select * from mychild129;
SELECT 4360604
alter table mychild130 add primary key(mykey asc, myseq asc);
ALTER TABLE
alter table mychild130 add foreign key (mykey) references mytest129(mykey) on delete cascade;
ysqlsh:clone_tables.sql:5: ERROR: Timed out: Timed out waiting for Alter Table
create table mytest131 as select * from mytest129;
```
I ran into same or similar issue while trying to setup test environment, so problem is narrowed down to `ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY` on a table with data.

I created a new rf=3 cluster:
```
$ bin/yb-ctl create --rf=3

Waiting for cluster to be ready.

| YSQL Shell          : bin/ysqlsh                                                                 |
| YCQL Shell          : bin/ycqlsh                                                                 |
| YEDIS Shell         : bin/redis-cli                                                              |
| Web UI              : http://127.0.0.1:7000/                                                     |
| Cluster Data        : /home/amartsin/yugabyte-data                                               |
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For more info, please use: yb-ctl status
```
In the ysqlsh:
```
yugabyte=# create table mytest129(mykey int primary key, myvalue text);
CREATE TABLE
Time: 1163.959 ms (00:01.164)
yugabyte=# insert into mytest129 select i, 'mytest ' || i::text from generate_series(1, 2180302) i;
INSERT 0 2180302
Time: 242104.873 ms (04:02.105)
yugabyte=# create table mychild129(mykey int, myseq int, myvalue text, primary key (mykey, myseq));
CREATE TABLE
Time: 446.205 ms
yugabyte=# insert into mychild129 select i, j, 'mychild ' || i::text || ', ' || j::text  from generate_series(1, 2180302) i, generate_series(1, 2) j;
INSERT 0 4360604
Time: 608915.706 ms (10:08.916)
yugabyte=# alter table mychild129 add foreign key (mykey) references mytest129(mykey) on delete cascade;
ERROR:  Timed out waiting for Alter Table
Time: 60018.922 ms (01:00.019)
```
